verdict.rationale: Gide publishes an insight on French BSPCE taxation under the 2026 finance law. It also has a dedicated employee share schemes team working 'in France and internationally'. That shows first-party publishing on at least one jurisdiction-specific startup instrument. Beyond France, nothing shows publications on other markets' instruments, and the evidence is a single listed article. Missing for 10: publications on non-French instruments (e.g. UK EMI, German VSOP, Indian FDI/ESOP rules), evidence of a broader or ongoing publication series, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments and rules of my market — e.g. UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE
